model.claim: linear ansatz/control experiment; efficacy and generalization require measured results

conditioned_field.claim: GeoBC candidate baseline; no new-algorithm or generalization claim

decoder.precision: native TCNN FP16 computation, FP32 master parameters, float32 returned output

encoder.pooling: concatenated masked max and masked mean

conditioned_field.conditioning: existing local BC/material features followed by global geometry descriptor
conditioned_field.geometry_source: fixed per-CAD normalized xyz only; prefer unique original boundary FEM nodes
conditioned_field.geometry_sampling: CAD-key/seed-stable sampling without replacement; masked padding for small clouds
conditioned_field.context_gradient: index_select/concatenate preserve gradients through native TCNN inputs
conditioned_field.context_training_cache: clouds only; re-encode once per unique CAD each optimizer step
conditioned_field.control: none/id retain the same decoder condition dimension and width as shape
conditioned_field.id_policy: fixed case identity codes for a diagnostic only; cannot encode unseen geometry

model.coefficient_source: external target-independent reference-load metadata; no files parsed here
model.input_layout: original25 BC/material + optional13 local geometry + shared global geometry descriptor
model.scale_policy: trainer fits one train-only RMS(u_mm) scalar; center0; same scale for all basis components and loads
model.physical_decode: u_mm = common_u_scale_mm * scaled_u; no per-load bias or learned scale
model.stress_policy: No stress output, training, scale fitting or linear stress combination in this module
model.linearity_scope: linear_basis only, with identical geometry and nonload BC/material/local features; load_dependent_basis need not be load-linear

geometry.source: canonical ver geometry only; same context for all loads
